title: About Me
paragraphs: Hey, I'm Jason! I grew up in Michigan and graduated from Western Michigan University in 2013. After a few years I made the move out to San Francisco in 2017, where I enrolled in a coding bootcamp and kicked off my career in software engineering.

When I'm not writing code, you can usually find me on the tennis court. I've been playing for years and have recently gotten into padel, which has been a blast. I also have a mini golden retriever named Callie who keeps me busy.
Feel free to explore and get in touch if you'd like to collaborate or just have a chat!
